editorial:
Imagine you and your four best friends have a secret spot where you can all cheat on your wives without getting caught. That is exactly what happens here. These guys share a hidden loft and each person has a key. It sounds like a dream for them until they walk in one day and find a dead girl on the floor. Since only the five of them have keys, you know right away that one of these friends is a killer. The vibe is tense and sneaky, making you feel like you are right there in the room while these guys start lying to each other's faces.

What really works is how the movie keeps you guessing. The pacing is quick, and the twists are actually surprising. While some of the characters are hard to like because they are all cheating, watching them fall apart is the best part. If you enjoy a good whodunit, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you like having physical movies. Streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video is also a great way to see all the small details in the loft.
endingExplained: You find out that the man who seemed the most innocent was actually the killer. He killed the woman because she knew too much about his secrets. He tried to frame the other friends to save himself. In the end, the truth comes out through a series of lies and clues. The police finally catch him, and his perfect life falls apart just like he feared it would from the start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves a good mystery with a big twist.
